title: The Near village down the road
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：near　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 near 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the teacher wrote of ① a near village down the road in the notebook, and everybody in the classroom said at once that it was ② nearer than the one named there the year before. Three terms on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the teacher, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the near ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the nearest village down the road anybody in the classroom had ever seen, or so the notebook for March 1952 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too near to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the pupil who had come to help; the near ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a near relative of the family, and said that no pupil in his right mind would call it ⑥ as near as the relative of the family they had once had in the old classroom. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was near or not, and he said so.

By 1965 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the notebook. What the line asked for was ⑦ something near, and nothing besides. The pupil from the next classroom called the whole plan ⑧ quite near; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the notebook kept the names of the near ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1968, at once, she wrote of another near village down the road in the same notebook, and the work, which took two terms, seemed ⑨ nearer than anybody had expected. ⑩ The nearest relative of the family in the whole classroom, she said in 1970, was the one she could never quite name; the near ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 近（前置定语 a near village down the road：1958 年先生在笔记簿里记下的那件近的邻村）
B. adj. 近／亲近（比较级 nearer than：文中两处，一处比路那头的邻村，一处比预想）
C. adj. 近／亲近（最高级 the nearest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 近（表语 too near to do：母亲觉得它太近，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 亲近（前置定语 a near relative of the family：叔叔把整件事称作一桩亲近的近亲）
F. adj. 亲近（同级比较 as near as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩家里的近亲相比）
G. adj. 亲近（后置定语 something near：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 亲近（受程度副词修饰 quite near：那位学童的评价）

items.q: a near village down the road
the nearest village down the road anybody
a near relative of the family
The nearest relative of the family in

answers.why: near 意为“近”，1958 年先生在笔记簿里记下的是“一件近的邻村”，此处作前置定语 a near village down the road。
near 意为“近”，此处用比较级 nearer than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
near 意为“近”，笔记簿上 三月 那行字说它是教室里最近的一件，故用最高级 the nearest village down the road。
near 意为“近”，母亲认为这件东西“太近了，谁也用不上”，too near to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
near 意为“亲近”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩亲近的近亲”，此处作前置定语 a near relative of the family。
near 意为“亲近”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩家里的近亲一样亲近”，同级比较用 as near as。
near 意为“亲近”，笔记簿上那半行字要的是“亲近的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something near。
near 意为“亲近”，邻教室来的那位学童认为这套计划“相当亲近”，quite 修饰原级 near。
near 意为“亲近”，1968 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要亲近”，故用比较级 nearer than。
near 意为“亲近”，母亲 1970 年说的是“整个教室里最亲近的那一桩”，故用最高级 the nearest relative of the family。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年，先生在笔记簿里记下了一件近的邻村。（a near village down the road）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更近。（nearer than …）
母亲觉得它太近，谁也用不上。（too near to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩亲近的近亲。（a near relative of the family）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩家里的近亲一样亲近。（as near as …）
到了 1965 年，笔记簿上只剩半行字：要的是一件亲近的东西。（something near）
answers: In 1958 the teacher wrote of a near village down the road in the notebook.
Everybody said it was nearer than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too near to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a near relative of the family.
He said nobody would call it as near as the relative of the family they had once had.
By 1965 the notebook asked for nothing but something near.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 near 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1958 the teacher wrote of a near village down the road in the notebook, and nobody forgot it.
It was the nearest village down the road in the classroom, or so the notebook says.
My mother thought it too near to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a near relative of the family, and nobody argued with him.
The pupil from the next classroom called the plan quite near, and everybody laughed.
The near ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
